description: This file defines a migration class for updating the database schema as part of the OrangeHRM system to version 4.3.2. It includes methods to modify email configuration settings, such as migrating the sendmail path, and altering table schemas.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for executing database schema and data migrations during system upgrade to version 4.3.2.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration by fetching existing email sendmail path, inserting a new configuration value, updating the old value if it exists, and modifying the database schema by removing the sendmail_path column and adding a new 'type' column to the marketplace addon table.
